prof_rowan.name: Prof. Rowan
dialog: Prof. Rowan: Hm! You were about to walk into the tall grass without a Pokémon of your own?
Prof. Rowan: My briefcase is on the path, just over there. There are three Poké Balls inside.
Prof. Rowan: Go on. Choose the Pokémon that will be your partner.

pokemon_breeder_m.name: Breeder
dialog: Pokémon grow stronger every time they battle.
Walk through the tall grass and you'll never be short of wild ones to battle.

cashier_m.name: Mart Clerk
dialog: I work at the Poké Mart in Sandgem Town, at the east end of this road.
Come by when your Pokémon need Potions!

school_kid_m.name: Schoolboy
dialog: You can jump down a ledge, but you can't climb back up one.
It's the quick way back toward Twinleaf Town.

lass.name: Lass
dialog: Sandgem Town is where this road ends.
The Professor's lab is the big building on your left as you come in.

signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
Wild Pokémon live in tall grass. Weaken one in battle, then throw a Poké Ball to catch it.
